chapter: The China offer, wedding and Shanghai
title: Half the band goes home; the Casa Nova band and the Five Hot Shots
summary: Worried parents sent money for several band members to leave, so Clayton continued with a small band, and the bassist Reginald Jones stayed behind.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: That's right. So we stayed there. And finally the only reason we left was because some of the mothers of these guys at home had got worried and sent them money to come home. So half the band went home.
They had heard that there's this trouble?

Yes. So when we left we played another club where There were only about six of us, six or eight because these others had gone back home. I sent my wife back home, 'cause I didn't know what was going to happen. So we stayed over there and we had another beautiful six months. Nobody hoth ered us any more. And we stayed until our time was up......

BUCK CLAYTON
REELS I AND II
3 3/4 IPS
DANCE : Buck Clayton, Tape II continuing the period in China.

Well, after the Canadome the Casa Nova club with about seven guys, seven people. And also we had, there had been some dancers that came over there from Europe called the "Five Hot Shots". They were all from Harlem. But they had played Paris, Germany and had come around through that way into China. And they were in Shanghai also along with us.

So they were playing at a place there called "Paramount". But you see, after the Canadome some of my fellows got money from home. Their parents wanted them to come back because they were afraid there may be some more trouble. Also they were afraid there was going to be a war between the Japanese, Japan and China, which there was.
So, six of them left. I stayed with all the rest and we played this, this new club until I decided that we all should go home. But everybody decided to go home except one fellow, that was our
bass player Reginald Jones. He had met a girl the from Philippine Islands over there and he didn't want to come back home.
